verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability in the evidence is bulk-importing configuration variables from a .env file or stdin, followed by a hot-reload. That is a real many-items-at-once operation, but it is limited to one agent's environment variables. The scriptable CLI and idempotent provisioning are building blocks a user could loop over, not bulk operations themselves, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: bulk actions across many agents (e.g. batch deploy, update, delete or restart), bulk endpoints in the API/SDK, documented batch semantics such as partial-failure handling, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
